stories.tz: 尼日利亚知名福音歌手托鲁瓦尼辛斯去世，享年41岁
stories.sz: 他的家人呼吁粉丝在这个哀悼期将他的妻子、孩子和家人放在祈祷中。

stories.t: Why is Starlink internet so important on the battlefield in Ukraine?
stories.s: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.
stories.tz: 为什么星链互联网在乌克兰战场上如此重要？
stories.sz: 它是“乌克兰军事通信的骨干”，为全国各地的部队提供至关重要的高速互联网。

stories.t: Obama says drift towards extremism 'not inevitable'
stories.s: More than 12,000 people filled a major venue in the city to hear the former US president's take on the challenges the world is facing. .
stories.tz: 奥巴马称滑向极端主义“并非不可避免”
stories.sz: 1万多名民众挤满该市的一处大型场馆，聆听这位美国前总统对世界所面临挑战的看法。

stories.t: Two dead in Istanbul after heaviest rainfall in 84 years, governor says
stories.s: Residents have been told to avoid leaving their homes unless absolutely necessary.
stories.tz: 伊斯坦布尔遭遇84年来最大降水致两人死亡，当地长官称
stories.sz: 当局已呼吁居民除非绝对必要，否则尽量避免出门。

stories.t: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
stories.s: Lula's supporters hope the measure will boost his popularity ahead of a presidential run-off in 10 days.
stories.tz: 巴西国会批准缩短每周工作时间，卢拉迎来政治胜利
stories.sz: 卢拉的支持者希望此举能在10天后的总统决选前提升他的支持率。

stories.t: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
stories.s: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.
stories.tz: 官员称在短暂停火后，乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击
stories.sz: 周四清早，乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯梁赞州的一处炼油厂。此前数小时，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基宣布莫斯科方面拒绝的短暂停火已经结束。

stories.t: Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training
stories.s: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.
stories.tz: 来自墨西哥城的问候：尽管斗牛被禁，这位斗牛士仍在训练
stories.sz: 在这个墨西哥首都已被禁止的运动中，两人正在上演一场死亡之舞的排练，一人扮演公牛，另一人扮演斗牛士。

stories.t: Ukraine says its Starshield access is back
stories.s: Ukraine says its access to SpaceX's Starshield has been restored. It's the system the country uses for its offensive drone attacks on Russia.
stories.tz: 乌克兰称其星盾访问权限已恢复
stories.sz: 乌克兰表示，其对太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）“星盾”系统的访问权限已恢复。该国正是利用这一系统对俄罗斯发动无人机进攻。

stories.t: Rep. Mike Quigley, D-Ill., on reports Ukraine's Starshield access was restricted
stories.s: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Democratic Rep. Mike Quigley of Illinois about reports that SpaceX temporarily restricted access to its Starshield in Ukraine, affecting the country's war efforts.
stories.tz: 美国伊利诺伊州民主党众议员迈克·奎格利谈乌克兰星盾访问权限受限的报道
stories.sz: 美国全国公共广播电台（NPR）的米歇尔·马丁采访了来自伊利诺伊州的民主党众议员迈克·奎格利，探讨了关于SpaceX临时限制乌克兰使用其“星盾”系统并影响该国战事的报道。

stories.t: White House defends new press secretary over her legal credentials
stories.s: Katie Zacharia does not appear to be registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.

stories.t: Pakistan school roof collapse kills at least 34 children and teacher
stories.s: Another three pupils from al-Khair school in Peshawar in critical condition after search for survivors At least 34 schoolchildren and a female teacher have died after the roof of a school collapsed during morning classes in the northern…

stories.t: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
stories.s: The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.

stories.t: Actor Imran Khan ordered to leave India after participating in protest
stories.s: The Bollywood actor had been detained and released while participating in a protest in Mumbai on 10 October.

stories.t: Coe aims for African 'legacy' with 2029 World Championships
stories.s: Hosting the World Athletics Championships in Nairobi in 2029 will leave a "legacy of experience and expertise", according to the sport's top official Sebastian Coe.

stories.t: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
stories.s: At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+…

stories.t: Indian woman and boyfriend get death sentence in 'blue drum' murder case
stories.s: The body was recovered from a large blue plastic storage container - locally called a drum.

stories.t: North Korea and China open new bridge after 12-year delay
stories.s: China is the North's largest trading partner and a lifeline against the sanctions Pyongyang faces.

stories.t: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings still have no public outcome, BBC Verify finds
stories.s: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.

stories.t: Indonesia fights fire with dry ice as toxic haze spreads across region
stories.s: Having tried cloud seeding and water bombing, one pilot project will see dry ice dispersed by plane across the province of South Sumatra As fires ravage Indonesia, emitting a toxic smoke that has drawn the ire of regional neighbours, the…

stories.t: Australian woman charged with lacing colleague's curry with snail poison
stories.s: The alleged victim, who was in a relationship with the woman, had spotted bright green pellets in the meal.

stories.t: Desperate to clear toxic haze, Indonesia douses its skies with dry ice
stories.s: Authorities in South East Asia have turned to weather modification as fires blanket the region in smog.

stories.t: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns
stories.s: Thick orange smog descended on the Indonesian city of Palangka Raya as wildfires continue raging nearby.
